description: This file implements a Calendar service for Lark Calendar, including authentication, event creation, updating, deletion, and fetching calendar data. It defines the LarkCalendarService class and a factory function for instantiation.

classes.name: LarkCalendarService
classes.description: A class implementing the Calendar interface for interacting with Lark Calendar API, handling authentication, event management, and calendar retrieval.

methods.name: parseEventTime2Timestamp
methods.description: Converts an event time string to a Unix timestamp string.

methods.name: createEvent
methods.description: Creates a new calendar event and handles attendees; returns the created event data.

methods.name: updateEvent
methods.description: Updates an existing calendar event identified by UID.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes a calendar event by UID.

methods.name: getAvailability
methods.description: Fetches free/busy times for specified calendars within a date range.

methods.name: listCalendars
methods.description: Retrieves list of accessible calendars, prioritizing primary calendars.

methods.name: translateEvent
methods.description: Converts internal CalendarServiceEvent to LarkEvent format.

methods.name: translateAttendees
methods.description: Converts internal attendees to LarkEventAttendee format.
